mechanism: Erythromycin inhibits CYP3A4, which may increase clotrimazole levels; clotrimazole may also inhibit CYP3A4, creating potential for mutual enzyme inhibition.
action: Monitor for increased clotrimazole adverse effects (nausea, hepatotoxicity); consider alternative antifungal or macrolide if topical clotrimazole is being used systemically.
